propositions: Command syntax is currently split across imperative argv loops, hand-maintained help files, and inline argparse construction, causing drift between parser, runtime help, and documentation
A single argparse factory per command grammar must be established and used by both runtime handlers and help generation, with no duplicate parsers or alternative frameworks
Generated package-help files and grouped overview must be byte-deterministic and current, served before operation/config/store/handler boundaries
Parser migrations must capture and preserve argv accept/reject parity, diagnostics, exit codes, and stream behavior between old imperative parsers and new factories
Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, contradictory policy, missing generated resources, and unresolved parser references without importing handlers
Existing command execution must continue using the compatibility route ladder while each selected handler consumes its shared factory
